cases.title: Masthead shows the shop location's full identity details
cases.custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A work order exists whose shop location has a name, street address, city, state or province, postal code, and phone number all set.
3. To open the document on screen: click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order (click its row), then click the "Finance" tab. The document appears on the right.
4. Use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle above the document to switch between the Estimate and the Invoice.
cases.custom_steps:
1. Click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order, click the "Finance" tab, and use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle to show the document you need.
2. Look at the masthead (the header block at the top of the document).
cases.custom_expected:
1. The masthead shows the shop location's name.
2. It shows the shop location's street address, city, state or province, postal code, and phone number.
3. All of these identity details read exactly as they are entered for the shop location.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9140 (Story 1, Masthead and Letterhead) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, section S1-R1, read on 31 August 2026.
Design: the Design Document (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/c88ee207-3197-4f54-8cb9-bac3deb84354) — open "Customer Documents" → "Estimate", then the masthead at the top of the sheet — the shop block, the document number and the date labels.

cases.title: Credit Invoice never shows Remit Payment To and Credit To spans full width
cases.custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You need a credit on a customer account at a shop that HAS a remit-to payee configured, so that an ordinary invoice from that shop does show a "Remit Payment To" block.
3. Your active location must be the location the credit was issued at. Credits are location-specific: a credit issued at another location does not appear in the customer's Invoices list at all - no row and no print button.
4. To open the Credit Invoice: click "Customers" in the top menu, open the customer, click the "Invoices" tab, find the credit's row (its number, for example CM-100, is in the "No." column next to ordinary invoice numbers), then click the print icon at the right of that row (its tooltip reads "Print credit memo").
5. If the credit is fully applied, fully refunded or voided, turn the "Open only" filter off first or its row is not listed.
cases.custom_steps:
1. Click "Customers" in the top menu, open the customer, click the "Invoices" tab, and click the print icon on the credit's row to open the Credit Invoice.
2. Look at the addresses area near the top of the document.
3. Check whether a "Remit Payment To" block appears anywhere on it.
4. Note how much of the width of the addresses area the "Credit To" block takes up.
cases.custom_expected:
1. No Remit Payment To block appears on the Credit Invoice even though a remit-to payee exists.
2. The 'Credit To' block spans the full width of the addresses area (S2-R3, Section 3 matrix).
